title: factory.dispatch-result/v1 output artifact — one ticket run's terminal outcome (WM-108)

outcome.description: Terminal state of the ticket run: PR_OPEN (verified, PR opened, ticket In Review), BLOCKED (typed question posted, ticket Blocked), FAILED (work attempted but no shippable diff), NOT_CLAIMED (claim lost or ticket no longer dispatchable at claim time — the typed NOOP of docs/event-runtime-dispatch.md §2)

repo.description: Short repo name the run worked in, echoed from the input

ticket.description: Linear issue identifier this run implemented, echoed from the input

prUrl.description: URL of the opened pull request when outcome is PR_OPEN; null for every other outcome

verification.description: The ticket's own Verification Command as actually run in the worktree — never a claim without output

command.description: Exact verification command executed, or null when the run never reached verification (BLOCKED/NOT_CLAIMED)

passed.description: Whether the verification command exited zero; must be true for outcome PR_OPEN

output.description: Tail of the verification command's output (last lines, enough for a reviewer to see the pass/fail evidence); empty when no command ran

summary.description: One line an operator can act on: what shipped, what blocked, or why nothing happened
